'''Neva''' (Japanese: '''ユキノ''' ''Yukino'') and '''Tanner''' (Japanese: '''ナツキ''' ''Natsuki'') are two minor characters who appeared in ''[[M16|Genesect and the Legend Awakened]]''. They are residents of [[New Tork City]].

They were first seen walking home with their mother [[Diona]], who called out their names when they were lagging behind. She told them that they would get sandwiches when they get home. Later, when the [[Genesect Army|Red Genesect]] was fighting with {{OBP|Mewtwo|M16}} amongst the skyscrapers of New Tork City, both siblings were asleep in their shared bedroom while their Eevee became annoyed by the nearby {{pkmn|battle}}.

The siblings reappeared in the ending credits, where they were two of the guests taking a tour of [[Pokémon Hills]] with [[Eric]].
